guard_streams.write_limit: The interactive report is a presentation layer for annual aggregate data. It is not an exact selected-parcel source and cannot replace file-level validation.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the interactive report on 5 December 2024.
The page identifies the product as the Connected Nations 2024 interactive report.
Ofcom recommends expanding the embedded report to full screen for the best experience.
The page embeds the interactive Connected Nations report.
The page links to downloadable data underpinning Connected Nations.
The related Connected Nations publication says the interactive report supports different area views.
The related publication says it supports views for specific communications services.
The page provides an English/Welsh interface option.
Questions and feedback are directed to the Connected Nations data team.
The interactive presentation is kept separate from exact postcode-file and parcel-join evidence.

guard_streams.write_limit: Connected Nations 2023 downloads are historical file assets. They cannot verify current selected-parcel coverage or measured speed.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the 2023 data-download page on 2 January 2024.
The page was last updated on 28 March 2025.
The downloads are intended to support year-on-year infrastructure comparisons.
Ofcom links terms of use and licence conditions for the data.
The catalogue lists fixed UK and nations coverage data as a 5.4 KB ZIP.
It lists postcode-unit fixed coverage data as a 26.5 MB ZIP.
It lists postcode-unit fixed performance data as a 49.0 MB ZIP.
It lists fixed coverage census output-area data as a 10.6 MB ZIP.
The catalogue links separate about-the-data PDFs for its datasets.
Questions and feedback are directed to the Connected Nations data team.

guard_streams.write_limit: Contract-price, notice and service-quality rights are consumer protections. They do not establish physical broadband availability, live orderability or parcel-measured speed.

facts.detail: Ofcom first published the contracts page on 21 September 2015.
The page was last updated on 26 June 2026.
The page tells customers to check whether monthly charges stay the same during the contract.
It advises checking the minimum term and required notice period.
It addresses rights when agreed terms change or increase unexpectedly.
It explains fixed monthly prices and prices that rise on a specified date.
The monthly amounts should be provided clearly before sign-up.
An increase beyond the agreed terms requires at least one month's notice and a penalty-free exit right.
Pre-agreed rises must be clear in pounds and pence and specify when they occur.
Businesses may request clear contract information including restrictions and minimum service-quality levels.

guard_streams.write_limit: The CMR interactive portal is aggregate market and consumer-research evidence. It cannot establish selected-parcel network availability or measured performance.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the CMR 2026 interactive data on 30 June 2026.
The portal includes data collected from industry by Ofcom.
It includes data from Ofcom consumer research.
It includes headline figures from selected third parties.
The market-in-context section covers advertising, affordability and service take-up.
A television and audiovisual section covers revenues, viewing and content.
A radio and audio section covers revenues, listening and podcast research.
The telecoms section includes revenues, volumes and market shares.
The telecoms section includes average monthly spend and home-broadband performance data.
The online section includes app use, online experiences and internet-connectivity take-up.
